about: Rough renovation in a new-build apartment

In a new-build apartment from the developer, the rough stage is the foundation of the whole renovation: it decides whether walls are flat enough for tiles, whether there are enough sockets and whether fresh screed will have to be chased. That is why we route electrics and plumbing to a furniture and appliance plan — even if there is no design project yet.
After the rough stage the apartment is ready for finishing: tiles, flooring, painting, doors. You can order it from us — see new-build renovation — or do it with another team.

There is no separate rate per m² for rough renovation: the price depends on the number of partitions, electrical and plumbing points, plaster and screed thickness and materials. We price it per estimate after a site survey — the survey is paid, its cost is individual.
For a full turnkey renovation the benchmark is from $550/m²: works and rough materials, finishing materials extra.

faq: Do you do rough renovation only?
Yes. We do the rough stage separately if you plan the finishing yourself or with another contractor.
Demolition, partitions, electrics, water supply and drainage, heating, wall plastering, floor screed, waterproofing of wet areas and ceiling preparation.
How much does rough renovation cost in Kyiv?
Per estimate after a site survey: the price depends on the scope of works and materials. The survey is paid; the cost is individual.
Do I need a design project for rough renovation?
Preferably: sockets, water outlets and lighting should match furniture and appliances. If there is no design, we prepare a furniture plan before starting.
12 months on completed works; you accept concealed works under certificates before they are closed up.
